lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in approximately 10-12 visible vertical columns. Within the primary flank region, each column contains 4-6 primary centroids with high luminance, decreasing in diameter as they approach the ventral boundary.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: The blobs are vertically aligned along bands of elevated pixel intensity that create a rectilinear grid, most prominent in the mid-flank section behind the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible; the primary ridge displays a sharp luminance contrast with a highlighted superior edge and a deep shadow inferior edge, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a unique high-density distribution of micro-blobs, significantly smaller in diameter and more tightly packed than the macro-blobs on the lateral flank.
